text:
I'm answering as a 61-year-old salaried employee trying to decide whether a keren hishtalmut beats a plain securities account.

**The chart I'd rather see: option ג, "כל השנים בעמודות"** (all the years as columns). Its three numbers at the bottom answer my question directly: "אחרי 5 שנים, נשאר בידיים 66,513 ₪" (after 5 years, what's left in hand), "מתוך זה הפקדתם 18,000 ₪" (of that, you deposited) and "אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך 19,595 ₪" (the same money in a securities account). The white line sitting far below the bars makes the gap obvious. I'd keep the table from option א under it.

## 1. My answer
I would open the keren hishtalmut. I'm fairly sure, maybe 8 out of 10. The reason is "הכסף של המעסיק +900 ₪ בחודש" (the employer's money, 900 ₪ a month). The page says "על כל שקל שלכם נכנסים עוד 3 שקלים" (for every shekel of yours, 3 more go in). A securities account gets none of that. I'm not fully sure because of the orange warning: "⚠ הנחה: אתם 2.5% והמעסיק 7.5%… האחוזים האמיתיים כתובים בהסכם העבודה" (assumption: you 2.5%, employer 7.5%; the real figures are in your work contract). So it depends on my employer actually paying, and I'd check my contract first. I'm 61, so 6 years takes me to 67. That's fine if I don't need the money before then.

## 2. Parts I actually used
- The three cards at the top, mainly the right-hand card about the employer's money.
- The orange warning line.
- The table under option א: "מה יש במגדל / חשבון ניירות ערך / קרן השתלמות" (what's in the tower / securities account / keren hishtalmut).
- The three numbers at the bottom of option ג.

## 3. Block by block
- **Title and subtitle:** skimmed. "כל הציורים חיים: אפשר לגרור את השנים" (all the drawings are live, you can drag the years). I'm looking at pictures, so that meant nothing to me.
- **Right card, "+900 ₪ בחודש":** used. It's the most important sentence on the page.
- **Middle card, "+32,225 ₪ הקפיצה בשנה 6"** (the jump in year 6): used. It told me to wait the full 6 years: "66,513 ₪ מול 98,738 ₪, כי המס נעלם" (66,513 against 98,738, because the tax disappears).
- **Left card, "+1,721 ₪ הכסף שלכם לבד":** confused me. It says "אחרי 5 שנים הקרן דווקא 394 ₪ פחות" (after 5 years the fund is actually 394 ₪ less). So without the employer it's roughly a wash. Fine, but then why bother telling me?
- **Grey small print about assumptions:** read it slowly and understood half. I took in "תשואה 7% בשנה, אינפלציה 2%, הכול בכסף של היום" (7% return a year, 2% inflation, all in today's money). The rest is names and codes.
- **א. מגדלי מטבעות (coin towers):** I looked at the coins and gave up counting them. The table underneath is excellent.
- **"אותו ציור שנה אחת אחר כך" (the same drawing one year later):** skimmed. I only took the 98,738.
- **ב. מדרגות (steps):** half-used. The step "מס במשיכה −13,974 ₪" (tax on withdrawal) is clear. The step "אותו כסף עובר לקרן +527 ₪" (same money moves to the fund) confused me.
- **ג. כל השנים בעמודות:** used, especially the bottom numbers.

## 4. Inside the charts and table
- **Table:** I read every row. The one that mattered was "הפקדות המעסיק" (employer deposits): "אין" (none) against "54,000 ₪". After that, "מס במשיכה" (tax on withdrawal) and the bold "נשאר בידיים" (left in hand). I barely looked at "רווח אחרי דמי ניהול" (profit after management fees).
- **Colours:**
  - Yellow means employer money. I got that straight away.
  - Pink stripes mean tax. Clear enough.
  - Teal, profit, I mostly ignored.
  - In the coins, the striped ones sit on top of the yellow ones, and I couldn't tell whether they're inside the 66,513 or taken out of it.
- **Year labels:** I watched the dotted line between "לפני 6 שנים: מס" (before 6 years: tax) and "מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס" (from 6 years: tax-free).
- **Axes:** I ignored the y-axis numbers (50,000, 100,000 and so on) and the label "שנים עד המשיכה" (years until withdrawal).

## 5. What I didn't understand
- "מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד S&P500 (13245)", "(5139282)", "4D" and "פייר פיננשיאל טכנולוג'יז". These seem to be fund names and ID codes, and I don't know who they are or why they're there.
- "עד התקרה בחוק" (up to the legal ceiling). What is the ceiling in shekels?
- Why the same money gains "+527" just by moving into the fund, when the fund's fees are higher (0.54% against 0.19%).
- "בין 19 המסלולים… 66,280 ₪ עד 67,028 ₪" (across the 19 tracks, 66,280 to 67,028). Do I have to pick a track? Which one?
- The "שכירים / עצמאים" switch (salaried / self-employed). I assumed "שכירים" is me and didn't touch it.

## 6. What I wanted and couldn't find
- What happens if I need the money before 6 years, other than paying tax. Can I take it out at all?
- What happens if I leave my job or retire at 64. Does the 6-year clock keep running?
- What happens if the market falls instead of rising 7%. Does the employer money still win?
- Whether my age changes anything.
- How to check whether my employer even offers this.

## 7. If half the page had to go
First to go would be the coin towers and the "same drawing one year later" repeat. Next, the small print with the fund codes, the coloured legend line and the drag hints. Then option ב, because ג already shows the same thing. I'd keep the three top cards, the orange warning, the table and option ג's three bottom numbers.
